After clarifying the situation, I understand that the issue was not caused by an individual staff member, but resulted from a management decision to withhold the prescription until a medication review was completed.

I fully understand the need for regular reviews and I did not refuse to attend one. An appointment had already been arranged. However, I was informed that I would need to stop my medication in the meantime. I explained clearly that abruptly stopping this medication can be unsafe and that I was unable to attend the initially offered appointment time due to work commitments, not because I was unwilling to engage in the review process.

Although I was told a short emergency supply could be issued until the scheduled appointment, this was not actioned. Two days later, after submitting a new request, another staff member responded promptly and confirmed the prescription would be provided.

This inconsistency and the initial management decision caused unnecessary stress and concern regarding continuity of care. I hope the practice reviews its prescribing and communication procedures to ensure patient safety is
